trial_court: Court of Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Purba Burdwan, Matrimonial Suit No.394 of 2021
case_name: Arpita Paul (Pain) v. Sovan Kumar Paul
facts_of_case: Matrimonial suit for divorce filed by Sovan Kumar Paul against Arpita Paul (Pain). Arpita Paul has already instituted cases under Section 498A IPC and Section 125 Cr.P.C. seeking maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish that the transfer is necessary for justice.
legal_principles.held: Bearing in mind the pendency of the criminal case, the petitioner/wife has sought for transfer of the Matrimonial Suit from the court of learned Additional District Judge, 4th Court, Purba Burdwan to the court of learned District Judge, Kalyani.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case if there is an arguable point involved in the case.
legal_principles.held: There is an arguable point involved in this case which may be best decided touching upon the merits of the case.

outcome.final_order: Stay of proceedings in the court below for a period of four weeks from hence.
